studies.notes: No final analyzed participant total or per-arm participant counts are printed in the saved article or its appendices. The main creativity analysis is topic diversity of generated ideas (Shannon entropy per dyad), reported in Section 5.1.1 (PDF p. 7, printed p. 302) and Figure 5a (PDF p. 8, printed p. 303). It accounts for the background factors associated with the participant exclusions in Section 4.1.1. The abstract describes the recruited sample as completing the task; this does not establish the post-exclusion analysis sample. The conversation-topic, idea-count, and idea-homogenization analyses likewise have no printed final participant counts. Footnote 12 does not resolve whether the researcher-only recordings fall within its audio-session total or how its exclusions overlap with those in Section 4.1.1. Auxiliary dyad, discussion, session, and recording counts are identified explicitly in other_counts and are not converted into people or combined by subtraction. No count is inferred from degrees of freedom, output counts, or demographic balancing. The full markdown, including references and Appendix A.1-A.6, was read; cited counts were checked against PDF text, and the quantitative figures were visually checked. The external OSF data linked in Appendix A.1 (PDF p. 15, printed p. 310) could not be inspected: both its API and the published file-list URL failed because network socket access was forbidden. No external supplemental count is confirmed.
